units: Inputs are sums of signed synaptic g increments, not measured membrane voltage or conductance. Input categories overlap: GABA/glutamate LN subset of all inhibition; excitatory LN subset of all excitation.
limits: The cohort is chosen from baseline first-seed OFF 1-2s, not independently localized causal neurons. Late phase means and LN activity do not prove causation. Adaptation is not calibrated to biology.
